author: J Young
text: We've had great experiences working with Brent and Myron on projects all across Whatcom County... usually for installation of Stormwater facilities. As a Civil Engineering firm, we see work from a wide variety of contractors and it's always good to know that when Premium services are on a job, we can expect great communication and quality work. The clients are always happy too which is honetsly the only thing that matters at the end of the day!

author: Brian H
text: Great service and competative price on heavy equipment rental. I've rental here a few times and the equipment is newer and clean and worked without any issues. On my last rental, they worked hard to accommodate my short delivery window and the invoice was actually a little lower than expected!

author: rubyluvspups
text: I cannot recommend Premium Services enough.  From my first phone call I have been extremely pleased with the speed, efficiency, attention to detail, quality work, friendly employees, excellent clean up, etc.  Brent and crew have been amazing to work with.  You won’t be sorry you called them.  I will definitely use them again and recommend them to anyone needing work done.

author: Shaums March
text:
Great company that gets it done!
Brent leads an amazing team of friendly and caring operators who come in and get the job done right the first time.
We have used him through out our development process multiple times, every time he and his crew have exceeded our expectations.
Thanks guys

author: Emma Smith
text: Brent and his crew went above and beyond for us. We had a pad put in for our RV and him and his crew were absolutely amazing. My husband is away in Alaska and I cant drive trailer. Not only did his crew build the pad, they moved the trailer onto the pad, leveled it out, plugged us into the power so I was ready to go. 100% reccomend Brent for any project.
